sentences.quote: Today, Spotify (NYSE: SPOT) announced that Founder and Chief Executive Officer Daniel Ek will transition to the role of Executive Chairman effective January 1, 2026.
sentences.text: On 30 September 2025 Spotify announced that founder Daniel Ek would become executive chairman from 1 January 2026, with co-presidents Alex Norstrom and Gustav Soderstrom promoted to co-CEOs and joining the board, reporting to Ek.

sentences.quote: This evolution formalizes how Spotify has successfully operated since 2023 with the co-presidents largely leading strategic development and operational execution of Spotify.
sentences.text: The company said this formalized how it had operated since 2023, with Ek taking a European-style chairman role covering capital allocation and long-term strategy.
In March 2026 Spotify named John Giraldo, previously of NBCUniversal, chief accounting officer effective 26 May 2026; Christian Luiga remains CFO.
Management guided to improved growth and margins in 2026 while reinvesting for long-term potential.
